Date:

Location:

Company:
Corning
Requisition Number: 77396
The company built on breakthroughs. ​
Join us.​
Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.  ​
How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward. ​
​At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.​
​Come break through with us.
Corning’s Environmental Technologies segment manufactures ceramic substrates and filter products for emissions control in mobile and stationary applications around the world.
Scope of Position:
Join Corning’s Environmental Technologies (CET) Division as a Vision System Intern within the Measurements and Controls Group. In this role, you will help design, prototype, test, and deploy computer vision systems that improve manufacturing process efficiency and quality. Your work will focus on prototyping vision solutions and collaborating with senior engineers to transition technologies from development to pilot lines and manufacturing.
Program Benefits
Hands-on experience with high-tech materials and manufacturing applications
Competitive salaries
Housing assistance
Travel reimbursement
Intern Activities
Networking and professional development events
Volunteer opportunities
Community involvement
Day to Day Responsibilities
Contribute to engineering projects developing vision systems for inspection, defect detection, and measurement.
Develop, train, and evaluate models for object detection, segmentation, using Halcon and deep learning frameworks.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams.
Set up and calibrate cameras and sensors for reliable data capture.
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across hardware and software during development and deployment.
Support on-floor trials, data collection, and performance assessments to drive iterative improvements.
Document technical processes, system requirements, test plans, and project progress for internal stakeholders.
Travel Requirements
0 - 20% travel
Hours of work/work schedule/flex-time
40 hrs/week
Expected to work hours required to successfully deliver project and support requirements.
Requirements
Pursuing a bachelor’s Master’s or PhD’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Robotics, Physics, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.
0-1 years of experience through coursework, labs, projects, or internships in robotics or automation.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or C#(strongly preferred).
Understanding of image processing fundamentals, linear algebra, and 2D/3D geometry; experience with camera calibration.
Basic understanding of robot kinematics, dynamics, and feedback control.
Hands-on experience with hardware (cameras, sensors, actuators, and embedded controllers).
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Availability for a 10-week internship during Summer 2027, with an expected graduation date of December 2027 or later
Interest in pursuing a full-time opportunity with Corning after graduation, if offered
Willingness to work at the posted location
Desired Experience/Skills
Experience with image processing tools such as Halcon and OpenCV.
Familiarity with machine learning and AI technologies. Experience with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch;
Exposure to 3D vision (stereo, point clouds).
Experience integrating vision with robotics or automation systems.
Experience in a manufacturing, warehouse, or lab automation setting is a plus.
Soft Skills
Effective Communication: Ability to clearly convey technical concepts.
Problem-Solving: Analytical skills to identify and resolve challenges.
Adaptability: Flexible in adjusting to changing project demands and technologies.
This position does not support immigration sponsorship.
​The range for this position is $1,635.00 - $3,185.00 biweekly.  Starting pay for the successful applicant is prescribed based on geographic location, nature of position, and year in school.
​
A job that shapes a life.
Corning offers you the total package.
Your well-being is our priority. Our compensation and benefits package supports your health and wellness, financial aspirations, and career from day one.
Company-wide bonuses and long-term incentives align with key business results and ensure you are rewarded when the company performs well. When Corning wins, we all win.
As part of our commitment to your financial well-being, we provide a 100% company-paid pension benefit with fixed contributions that grow throughout your career. Combined with matching contributions to your 401(k) savings plan, Corning’s total contributions to your retirement accounts can reach between 7% and 12% of your pay, depending on your age and years of service.
Our health and well-being benefits include medical, dental, vision, paid parental leave, family building support, fitness, company-paid life insurance, disability, disease management programs, paid time off, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) to support you and your family.
Getting paid for our work is important, but feeling appreciated and recognized for those contributions motivates us much more. That’s why Corning offers a recognition program to celebrate successes and reward colleagues who make exceptional contributions.
